title: Hard rule 3's bake-load filter stages (out-of-grid discard + dedupe) never execute in any test
evidence:
src := `{"board":{"w_tiles":8,"h_tiles":6},"spawn_candidates":[[1.1,1.2],[1.3,1.4],[1.5,1.6],[7.9,5.1],[-0.4,2.0],[2.0,6.4]],"districts":[{"name":"D","kind":"city","x":4,"y":3}],"terrain":{"water":[],"coast":[],"park":[]},"streets":{"arterial":[],"local":[]}}`
	testing.expectf(t, len(b.candidates) == 1, "pool must hold exactly 1 tile, got %d", len(b.candidates))
	testing.expectf(t, b.candidates[0] == [2]i32{1, 1}, "snapped pool tile wrong: %v", b.candidates[0])
detail: Stride 6 over 6 candidates subsamples only index 0, which is in-grid and unique. The out-of-grid discard and dedupe branches never run; deleting them passes the suite — the briefing's hard rule 3 is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Extend the fixture so subsampled indices include an out-of-grid point (e.g. move [7.9,5.1] to index 6) and a snapping duplicate; assert pool length and order.

title: District assignment + per-district ranges claimed as pinned (b) but no test asserts them
detail: Header pin (b) does not exist: board_district_at's tie-break/mirror contract and district_start's prefix-sum are asserted nowhere; the PR's 'pinned by tests' is false. candidate_district/district_start are read by no sim code.
recommended_fix: Add a loader test with >=2 districts asserting candidate_district values (including a tie) and district_start ranges; or delete the false pin claim.

title: District-scoping contradiction: map.odin/dublin_board.dem document own-district ATTACH pools; growth.odin implements a global ring — no test distinguishes
evidence:
core/map.odin:33-34: // board: the ATTACH family draws from the anchor's OWN district's pool (an
// estate never crosses a district boundary), and the derived cluster view is
core/growth.odin:532: // caller draws one index. The ring is GLOBAL (not district-scoped): the
demos/dublin_board.dem:7: # district pool — a cluster never crosses a district boundary).
detail: Two committed contracts contradict the implementation (and each other). The synthetic test board cannot distinguish global vs district-scoped rings, so the ruled interplay is both misdocumented and unpinned.
recommended_fix: Correct map.odin:30-36 and the .dem header to the global-ring ruling; add an attach test with an adjacent-district pool tile inside the ring pinning the chosen semantics.

title: Attach-family test cannot distinguish ATTACH from SEED draws and never asserts the claimed E31 separation
evidence:
// strays), on a pool tile, E31-valid. Pre-seed one terminal per district
	testing.expectf(t, len(terminals) > 0, "dublin ATTACH growth must spawn (the anchors sit on the pool)")
		testing.expectf(t, on_pool, "attach spawn %v is NOT on a pool tile", pos)
		testing.expectf(t, in_radius, "attach spawn %v sits outside the estate radius of every anchor (a stray)", pos)
detail: Every synthetic pool tile sits within radius of a seed anchor, and bias-1000 with no eligible cluster falls back to SEED — a dead attach path (growth_board_cluster_has_room always false) still passes. E31 separation is claimed, never asserted.
recommended_fix: Add a pool tile reachable only via attach (outside all seed radii) and assert pairwise terminal separation so family regressions and E31 violations fail.

title: App map-tunable (PP_MAP) and corrupt-asset fallback have zero coverage despite the app unit-test convention
evidence:
if env := os.get_env_alloc("PP_MAP", context.temp_allocator); env != "" {
			fmt.eprintfln("app: cannot read data/maps/dublin.json (%v) - falling back to the procedural map", rerr)
				fmt.eprintfln("app: dublin board failed to load: %s - falling back to the procedural map", lerr)
--- CI gate 2 already runs app unit tests ---
for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test
detail: PP_MAP value parsing (invalid -> dublin default), read-failure and load-failure fallbacks are acceptance-relevant ('tunable flip') yet untested; settings/noc_toggle/pullback show the app test convention exists.
recommended_fix: Extract boot map-source resolution into a pure proc (env string + loader outcome -> source/board_ok) and unit-test all four paths in app.

title: map_board_load's fail-loud contract pinned on only 1 of ~15 error paths; mid-load errors also leak the partial board
evidence:
return {}, "map_board_load: missing districts"
		return {}, "map_board_load: the 1-in-6 spawn pool is empty (degenerate asset)"
		return {}, "map_board_load: malformed terrain.water"
--- the only tested error path: ---
	testing.expect(t, err != "", "mismatched board dims must fail loud")
detail: Only dims-mismatch is pinned. Untested mid-load returns discard the partially-built board (cloned district names, candidates) — a leak the tracking-allocator CI rule would surface if exercised.
recommended_fix: Table-test each error string with minimal fixtures; free the partial board before `return {}` or document the leak-on-error contract.

title: Degenerate empty-pool guard in growth_plan_demand untested
detail: The guard is unreachable via the loader (empty pools fail loud); a hand-built empty board pinning 'no spawn, rng untouched' is absent. P3 defensive path.
recommended_fix: One-line unit test: empty-candidates board + growth window -> zero spawns, rng stream unchanged.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 100% (dual-run determinism: 48 procedural goldens + dublin_board T1/T2/replay present; core suite 240/240 green, run here). P1 ~60-70% (6/10): rule-3 filter+dedupe, district anchoring, attach-vs-seed distinction, app tunable/fallback unpinned — two claimed pins are partly/false. Overall ~65% < 80%.
recommended_fix: Close the four P1 gaps — bake-load filter stages, district assignment/ranges, attach-family distinction + E31 assertion, app map-source resolution — then re-run the gate for P1 >=90%.
